entities.summary: Max Garcia is an American professional football guard. He played college football for the Florida Gators and was recognized as second-team All-SEC in 2014. He was selected by the Denver Broncos of the National Football League (NFL) in the fourth round, 133rd overall, in the 2015 NFL draft.
